༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs lnga pa bzhugs so/ /sid+dhe shwa ra badz+ra tsār+ya s+ya ban+da nam kā ro mi grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon la gus pas phyag bgya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsan yig skabs lnga pa bzhugs so// sid+dhe shwa ra badz+ra tsār+ya s+ya ban+da nam kā ro mi ……grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje slob dpon la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /grub pa mchog gi byin rlabs gser gyi shing rta la chibs nas/ /shes rab mchog gis rgyal ba'i chos tshul 'od stong rab spros te/ /bde stong mchog gi kun gsal mtshan rtog chu 'dzin bral ba'i dbus/ /dge legs mchog gi dpal mnga' bzang po'i zhabs kyi chu skyes mchod/ /dpal sa gsum gyi mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo sgrub ba'i rgyal po chen po rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal sngar rdo rje theg pa'i dbang rjes gnang sogs legs par thob pa'i tshul ni dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bka' rnam par dag pa sa lugs thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shrī dhar+m+ma kā ya sa man+ta bha dra/……dpal chos sku kun tu bzang po/ sam+bho ga kā ya badz+ra satwa ……longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ nir+m+ma ṇa kā ya pad+ma ka ra ……sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ nā gen+d+ra rak+ṣi ta ……klu'i dbang po srung ba/ badz+ra rat+na ……rdo rje rin chen/ pradz+nyā gu ṇa ……shes rab yon tan/ shī la rwa dza ……tshul khrims rgyal po/ badz+roṣ+ṇi ṣa ……rdo rje gtsug tor/ shu bha sha rā ṇa ……dge skyabs/ shu bha pa sh+ya ……dge mthong / ne pā la ……bal po/ shākya ma ti ……shākya blo gros/ pradz+nya shī la ……sher rab tshul khrims/ rat+na rā dza ……dkon mchog rgyal po/ ma hā bhu mi paṇ+ḍū ā nan+ta gar+bha ……sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ā tsar+ya pu ṇ+ya gra ……slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /bhaṭ+ṭā ra ga ya sha dh+wa dza ……rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bhu mi paṇ+ḍu paṇ+ḍi tā nan+ta dhā dza shrī bha dra/……sa skya pa mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ār+ya ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ pra bha wān shrī ……'od ldan dpal/

a nan+ta badz+ra ……kun dga' rdo rje/ a nan+ta pu ṇ+ya ……kun dga' bsod nams/ rat+na dh+wa dza ……rin chen rgyal mtshan/ saṅgu ru puṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ma hā gu ru ā nan+ta dh+wa dza ……bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ma hā ya na dharma rā dzā nan+ta maṅga la dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mañju gho ṣā kā sha dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ tsakra nā tha pradz+nyā dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/……'khor lo'i mgon po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bhu mi paṇ+ḍu lo tsā mañju gho ṣā ā nan+ta puṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre ṇa shru te ……'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsa ba kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thos so/ /drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa yan gong dang 'dra ba la/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ thar pa 'dul khang / mkhan po thugs rje shes rab/ sngags 'chang dharma kidhi/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /pad+ma thod phreng rtsal drag po dmar chen gyi dbang bskur thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ mnga' bdag sras chung / bla ma bzu ston rin po che/ gu ru dharma rat+na/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol/ drin can sangs rgyas lhun dbang / sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/ sngags 'chang legs pa dpal bzang / 'khon sa skya pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/

se mkhar chung pa/ zhang dgon pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med rgyal mtshan dkon mchog byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang sru lung pa kun dga' smon lam gyi yig cha'i lugs bzhin thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ theg chen pa/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpal chos pa/ mu srad rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ shād+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag stengs pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ rje btsun sa skya pa kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma dam pa bdag nyid chen po/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/

des bdag la'o/ /dpal mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / slob dpon klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rat+na kīrti/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba chen po/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal tshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i phur bu'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku pad+ma'abyung gnas/ klu'i dbang po srung ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'od ldan dpal/ kun dga' rdo rje/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ kun bsod/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa gnyis/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i tho yig dang / sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che chung gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi yi ge/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams thos/ dkar bdud kyi gtor chog sgrub thabs 'khon rog gis mdzad pa/

rjes gnang bya tshul yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gu ru drag po'i dbang chog slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ de'i phrin las dang phur pa'i sgrub thabs chung ngu bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa yang thos// //bcu pa phreng ldan nang tshan gyi/ /dag snang zhes pa'i sdeb sbyor yin/ pradz+nyāgam+bhirabāramargal/ bhapaṇ+ḍitakasid+dhākīr+t+tayaḥ/ abh+yudāyaparidh+wadzen bhū/ tishrībhadrasid+dheshwaranamaḥ shes rab mchog gis zab mo'i lam rnyed nas/ /mkhas shing grub pa grags pa'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /gzhan las mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor zam mos brtson/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge legs shar gyi sa 'dzin phrag par 'od zer bye ba'i khrir bzhugs nas/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i mun pa sel la rtag bgros dri ma med pa yi/ /smon lam rta bdun gyis drangs phyogs kyi dri gzhon rab bskyed 'char kha'i mdangs/ /cher gsal 'chi med ngag dbang rigs kyi theg les phan bde'i 'bras bu stsol/ /mang du gsan pa rgya mtsho'i gter/ /snying po'i nor bu 'ga' zhig tsam/ /blo gros snyim par rab blangs te/ /legs bshad dbul ba sel bar byas/ /skye ba 'di dang phyi mar yang / /gsang chen snying po'i don bsgom zhing / /zab mo'i bzlas brjod la brtson pas/ /khyod bzhin nus mthu'i mthar phyin shog /rje btsun chen po dpal sa skya pa las brgyud pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i dbang / rjes gnang shin tu zab po'i gdams pa rnams thos pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod pa pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba las/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug 'khon gyi sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs rgya gar pradz+nyā dh+wa dza shrī bha dra'i zhal sngar shrī badz+ra ku mā ra'i dbang / dpal gur gyi mgon po ma hā kā la shrī tsa tur rmu kha la sogs pa'i rjes gnang dang gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa yongs su rdzogs pa nye bar nos pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/
